description.blurb: S/2006 S 9 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Norse group. It was discovered in 2006 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2006 S 9 is about 3 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 14.4 million km in 647.89 days. It has an inclination of 173.0° to the ecliptic in a retrograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.248.
